title: +*POLLINATORS IN PERIL
description: Explores the world’s pollinators and evaluates the potential consequences of pollinator decline. Analyzes competing interests of stakeholders, including those who most benefit from ecosystem services provided by pollinators, and those whose activities impact pollinators. Employs team collaboration to develop approaches to mitigate complex threats to pollinators, including pesticides, habitat fragmentation, climate change, invasive species, pests, pathogens, and other effects of human behaviors in natural and agricultural systems. CROSSLISTED as ENT 331/HORT 331.
registration_restrictions: Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.
